name: Laguna S 2.1
short: Poolside's 118B/8B-active open-weights MoE (1M, OpenMDW-1.1) for agentic coding: Terminal-Bench 2.1 70.2% (#12 at launch), runs on one DGX Spark.
pricingNote: \.10/\.20 per 1M (\.01 cache) on Poolside 1M endpoint; OpenRouter \.09/\.18
freeTierNote: Free OpenRouter endpoint at 256K context; self-host free under OpenMDW-1.1 (8B active, runs on a single NVIDIA DGX Spark)
standout: The desktop agent: 1M context and Terminal-Bench 2.1 70.2% from a model sized for a single DGX Spark.
tradeoff: No general-reasoning benchmark (GPQA, HLE, AIME) has ever been published, and the free 256K endpoint is deprecated.
pricingTiers: Poolside 1M endpoint $0.10/$0.20 per 1M in/out, $0.01 cached read; OpenRouter $0.09/$0.18
